name: Nahira sa-Qesh
source_profile:
Elder Nahira sa-Qesh (LN)

Nahira is an accomplished diplomat and one of the strongest advocates of a formal agreement with Cador. She believes that the kingdom's expanding population will eventually require passage through Qasari lands. Rather than fight an unwinnable war, she wants the crown to recognize the Qasari as an independent political people with legally protected territorial and water rights. She is particularly interested in negotiating directly with Marquis Cedric Bellamy, whose commercial interests could make him receptive to such agreements.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 68 (source excerpt; may be partial)
